verdict.rationale: Glama publishes a discoverable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for its MCP directory API, with /v1 paths for servers, connectors, instances and usage, plus a hosted reference with Try-it panels. That is real programmatic coverage, but the spec is scoped to the directory, and the Gateway is described as an MCP-protocol proxy with no separate REST spec. Nothing shows UI features like chat, the claim panel, hosting build configuration or per-tool access control are reachable via API. Missing for 10: documented API parity for chat, hosting/build configuration, gateway access-control and claim-panel actions; an explicit UI-to-API parity statement; independent confirmation of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
